facts.fact: The African Development Bank, a development finance institution, approved in January 2025 a $160 million senior corporate loan to AXIAN Telecom (Mauritius-headquartered) across nine countries, of which over $10 million is dedicated to 22,000 women entrepreneurs in Madagascar through the MVola platform; the article gives January 2025 as the approval date.
